title: What's new in v2.3.4
intro: This update improves performer detection and makes image metadata selection more automatic.
items: Added a fallback that reads performer names directly from the visible PornPics Models section, even when the model is not a normal performer link.
Matched or approved tags are now selected on all chosen photos by default.
Matched or approved performers are selected on all chosen photos by default.
You can still deselect individual tags or performers per photo.
